Parse Hive DDL without recovery

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "ts_pack.h"

int main(void) {
    TS_PACKAlefHandle config_handle = ts_pack_process_config_from_json("{\"language\":\"sql\"}");
    TS_PACKAlefHandle result = ts_pack_process("CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE t(`a` string, `b` array<string>)\nPARTITIONED BY (`p` string)\nROW FORMAT SERDE 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.serde.ParquetHiveSerDe'\nSTORED AS INPUTFORMAT 'x' OUTPUTFORMAT 'y'\nLOCATION 's3://{{bucket}}/t/'\nTBLPROPERTIES ('k'='v');", config_handle);
    ts_pack_process_config_free(config_handle);
    ts_pack_process_result_free(result);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
